note: Test fixture, not a deployment target: it is the second config on disk, so a test can prove the deploy script takes its allowlist from the file of the chain it runs on rather than from a list built into the script. The two entries are in descending address order on purpose, so that file order and ascending order differ and a script that sorted its allowlist would fail.
